fields.label: Patient ID
fields.description: The same patient identifier used elsewhere in this app's payloads (e.g. Call Logs.patient / start_consultation's uhis_patient_id) -- not a Link, since this must record the decision even when the client-supplied id never resolved to a local Patient record.

fields.label: Visit ID
fields.description: The visit/encounter the consent was captured during, if any.

fields.label: Language
fields.description: The language the SK actually saw -- not necessarily the app's current default, since Shukhee Consent.get_consent can fall back to English when the requested language has no configured row.

fields.label: Consent Version
fields.description: Echoed back from Shukhee Consent.version as returned by the get_consent call the client fetched right before this decision.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Resolved server-side via the same current_remote_user_id() -> Provider.username lookup api.consultation._current_provider() already uses -- never trusted from a client-supplied identity.

fields.label: Patient DOB
fields.description: Raw ISO date, for age-visibility in the audit trail -- deliberately just the raw fact, not a derived 'is minor' flag; this app does not branch consent capture on age.
